title: Iran's Araghchi Meets Qatari Mediators as US Pushes Nuclear Talks
detail: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met with Qatari mediators amid intensifying US pressure on Tehran to return to nuclear negotiations. Qatar has served as a key intermediary channel between Washington and Tehran throughout the diplomatic standoff following the IAEA Security Council referral.

media.caption: Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi meets Qatari mediators amid US nuclear talks pressure
